title: Enforce audit purge scope predicates
summary: Enforce the `audit.purge` `before_ms` scope predicate so scoped grants can cap destructive audit retention authority.
expectedFailureModes: A scoped audit purge grant can still purge a broader time range than the operator intended.
Retention predicates are validated at grant time but ignored at dispatch, undermining the capability scope model.
Scope rejections for destructive audit operations are not auditable.
verification: cargo clippy -p covenant-permissions -p covenant-audit -p covenantd --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
nextAction: Continue capability dispatch hardening with memory mutation predicate enforcement.
